maria-sec: Found a debug dump in partner staging backup with short-lived Vault tokens + svc keys. Dump dates to last-week. Starting a sweep.

sam-oncall: Can you paste the backup path? I'll spin up containment play.

maria-sec: path: s3://partner-staging-backups/2026-03-21/agent-debug.tar.gz
maria-sec: Looks like agent debug log accidentally included `VAULT_TOKEN` and GCP SA JSON blobs.

kai-eng: ACK. First step: revoke tokens and mark associated vault tokens as compromised.

julian-devops: On it. Will run:
```
# revoke known token prefixes
vault token revoke -prefix agent-debug-2026
# revoke service account keys found (placeholder)
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=agent-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

sam-oncall: I'll also update RBAC to block agent ingestion from that staging bucket until rotation completes.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0440. Assigned to maria-sec, julian-devops, kai-eng. Severity: medium.

maria-sec: Need KMS wrapping changes: these agents used our older KMS binding. We should rotate KEKs and rewrap secrets in Vault. Kai, can you coordinate rewrap job and push audit logs to Cloud Audit (export to GCS) for compliance?

kai-eng: Yes. Plan:
1) Generate new KMS key version and create grant for vault-proxy.
2) Run vault operator rewrap for affected paths.
3) Run canary on one cluster.
Will schedule a 30-min window after key creation.

julian-devops: I have a terraform plan to add a vault-rewrap job in k8s. Will open PR and tag @kai-eng for review. Also will add a `pre-rotate` smoke test.

maria-sec: Cutting privileges: update Vault ACL policy to deny token creation for `agent-debug` role until further notice. Also add audit device export for the keys touched.

sam-oncall: Who owns contacting the partner ops to ensure they remove the backup? They may have retained copies.

maria-sec: Partner ops: @partner-ops (cc:legal). I'll DM the contact and ask for secure delete + attest.

julian-devops: ETA on rotation tasks: key creation (10m), rewrap job (20m), canary (15m). Estimate full sweep 1 hour.

maria-sec: OK. Owners: maria-sec (containment + partner), julian-devops (key create + terraform), kai-eng (rewrap job + audit export), sam-oncall (RBAC block + smoke test). I'll update INC-2026-0440 with checklist.

security-bot: Audit export created: gs://redwood-security-exports/INC-2026-0440/

maria-sec: After rotation, we need to run the regression evals from Redwood Optimize to ensure inference doesn't regress; schedule a nightly job.

kai-eng: Will post rewrap run logs to thread and ping when canary passes.

sam-oncall: Noted. If any downstream client tokens break, we have a fallback policy to roll back to previous key within 10m window.

maria-sec: Great. I'll mark this thread as active; will post closure once audit confirms deletion and rewrap complete. :white_check_mark:
